A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''guard''' was posted at [[Darth Nyriss]]'s [[Darth Nyriss's stronghold|stronghold]] in [[3950 BBY]]. He and his [[Unidentified Human guard|companion]] were sent by Nyriss, to kill her prisoner&mdash;[[Revan/Legends|Revan]]&mdash;when her stronghold was [[Purge of the Dark Council|attacked]] by the [[Imperial Guard]]. He had a gun on Revan, and while his companion tried to convince him to kill the prisoner, Revan worked to persuade him otherwise. Revan managed to convince them not to kill him, by pointing out that his friend who were on the way would probably kill them if they found him dead, and promised to protect them.<ref name="Revan" />

When [[Meetra Surik]], [[T3-M4]], and [[Scourge (Sith)|Lord Scourge]] arrived, Revan stopped Scourge from killing the two guards. However, Nyriss arrived intent on stopping Revan, Surik, and Scourge from escaping. She killed both guards with her [[Force lightning/Legends|lightning]], turning their bodies to charred husks.<ref name="Revan" />
